title_zh: 大钟寺站—街—公园横向连接
decision_question_zh: 在不预设工程线位的前提下，哪一类干预值得进入现场调查与可逆试点准备？
decision_question_en: Without presuming an engineering alignment, which intervention class merits field investigation and reversible-pilot preparation?

claim_boundary.statement_zh: 本记录是非比例的概念决策协议，不是现状测绘、法定选址、道路线形、桥隧方案或工程可行性结论。
claim_boundary.statement_en: This record is a not-to-scale conceptual decision protocol, not a survey, statutory siting, road alignment, bridge or tunnel scheme, or engineering-feasibility conclusion.

provisional_geometry_mismatch.statement_zh: 当前临时重点区多边形 PROV-KEY-003 的质心距开放街图大钟寺站点约 2.26 km，表明临时矩形不足以承载站—街设计定位。本实验台因此只使用无地理坐标的关系剖面，不将任何方案叠加到该多边形。
provisional_geometry_mismatch.statement_en: The centroid of provisional key-area polygon PROV-KEY-003 is approximately 2.26 km from the open-map Dazhongsi station point, showing that the rough rectangle cannot support station-to-street siting. The lab therefore uses a non-georeferenced relational section and overlays no option on that polygon.

items.label_zh: 任务区及大钟寺站—街联系命题
items.label_en: Task context and Dazhongsi station-to-street question

items.label_zh: 开放街图中的站点、道路、公园与铁路上下文
items.label_en: Station, road, park and railway context in the open-map extract
items.limitation_zh: 完整性、现势性和无障碍属性未经现场核验。
items.limitation_en: Completeness, currency and accessibility attributes have not been field-verified.

items.label_zh: 精确站口、坡度、路缘、宽度、信号与施工状态
items.label_en: Exact exits, gradients, kerbs, widths, signals and construction status

items.label_zh: 事故、冲突、分群需求、权属、轨道安全、市政与维护成本
items.label_en: Crashes, conflicts, disaggregated demand, ownership, rail safety, utilities and maintenance cost

decision_lock.reason_zh: 强制证据门槛尚未满足。AI 只能比较概念假设并安排下一步调查，不能推荐 A、B 或 C。
decision_lock.reason_en: Mandatory evidence gates are not satisfied. AI may compare conceptual hypotheses and schedule the next investigations, but it cannot recommend A, B or C.
decision_lock.unlock_rule_zh: 六项资料完成来源、日期、责任人和现场复核登记，且安全、无障碍与运营责任无阻断性问题后，方可进入多案专业评审。
decision_lock.unlock_rule_en: All six inputs must record source, date, owner and field verification, with no blocking safety, accessibility or operational-responsibility issue, before professional option review may begin.

t1_field_evidence_minimum_package.purpose_zh: 形成 T1 横向连接比较所需的最小现场证据，不构成公众意见调查或工程测绘。
t1_field_evidence_minimum_package.purpose_en: Create the minimum field evidence needed for T1 transverse-connection comparison; this is neither a public-opinion survey nor an engineering survey.
t1_field_evidence_minimum_package.authorization_required_zh: 由合法场地与调查责任主体确认进入、观察、陪同走测、数据保存和安全方案后方可开展。
t1_field_evidence_minimum_package.authorization_required_en: Proceed only after the lawful site and survey duty holders approve access, observation, accompanied walks, data retention and the safety plan.

paired_walk_unit.description_zh: 同一路径采用代表使用者陪同走测与专业观察员复测成对记录；每次记录相同起讫、时段、天气与施工状态。
paired_walk_unit.description_en: Pair an accompanied walk by a representative user with a repeat audit by a professional observer on the same origin, destination, period, weather and construction state.

representative_users_and_consent.requirements_zh: 自愿、可撤回、易懂的知情同意；提供交通、陪同与无障碍支持；不以参加换取基本服务。
representative_users_and_consent.requirements_en: Voluntary, withdrawable and understandable informed consent; provide travel, accompaniment and accessibility support; never condition basic service on participation.

time_windows.note_zh: 早晚、工作日与周末须成对覆盖；极端天气另作安全判断，不强制参与者暴露。
time_windows.note_en: Cover morning/evening and weekday/weekend in paired observations; assess extreme weather separately without forcing participant exposure.

qa_and_independent_review.requirements_zh: 校准计时与记录表；保留原始观察、异常和缺失；由未参与首轮采集的无障碍/交通专业人员抽查复走和结论。
qa_and_independent_review.requirements_en: Calibrate timing and forms; retain raw observations, anomalies and missingness; have an accessibility/transport professional not involved in first collection sample and repeat walks and findings.

privacy_minimization.requirements_zh: 不拍摄可识别面部或车牌，不记录姓名、精确个人轨迹或无关身份；仅保存分群、聚合与必要观察，设定删除日期。
privacy_minimization.requirements_en: Capture no identifiable faces or plates and record no names, precise personal traces or irrelevant identity; retain only grouped, aggregated and necessary observations with a deletion date.

comparison_method.ai_role_zh: 公开计算权重敏感性、重叠区间、硬约束和缺失资料；不生成黑箱最优解。
comparison_method.ai_role_en: Expose weight sensitivity, overlapping intervals, hard constraints and missing evidence; do not produce a black-box optimum.
comparison_method.warning_zh: 区间仅编码干预类型的设计假设，用于测试排序是否敏感；不是现场绩效预测，也不能解锁决定。
comparison_method.warning_en: Bands encode design hypotheses about intervention classes only, to test ranking sensitivity. They are not site-performance forecasts and cannot unlock a decision.

modes.summary_zh: 登记阻隔命题与资料断点，不把示意线当作现状路线。
modes.summary_en: Register the barrier question and evidence gaps without treating the diagram as an existing route.

modes.summary_zh: 先比较人工协助、固定导视、信号时段和可撤设施。
modes.summary_en: First compare staffed assistance, fixed wayfinding, signal timing and removable elements.

modes.summary_zh: 在现场与专项条件支持时，研究连续坡道、过街、界面开放与休息节点。
modes.summary_en: If field and specialist conditions support it, study a continuous ramp, crossing, opened interface and rest point.

modes.summary_zh: 仅保留为远期比较类型；在轨道、安全、权属和工程资料缺失时退出当前清单。
modes.summary_en: Retain only as a long-term comparison class; remove it from the current shortlist while rail, safety, ownership and engineering evidence is missing.

actions_zh: 人工无障碍协助与同等非数字入口
现场核验后的固定导视与临时提示
经主管与运营主体同意的时段或信号试验
actions_en: Staffed accessibility assistance and equivalent non-digital access
Fixed wayfinding and temporary cues after field verification
Time-window or signal trials only with competent and operator approval

hard_constraints.label_zh: 人工与非数字同等入口

actions_zh: 连续无障碍链条与过街界面概念研究
可进入首层或边界开放的条件式比较
遮荫、停留与导视组成的小尺度公共节点
actions_en: Concept study for a continuous accessible chain and crossing interface
Conditional comparison of accessible ground floor or opened edge
Small public node combining shade, rest and wayfinding

actions_zh: 只保留跨越或下穿类型的比较席位
不绘制线位，不推定净空、结构或工程可行性
待专项资料齐备后由有资质团队另行论证
actions_en: Keep only a comparison slot for overpass or underpass classes
Draw no alignment and presume no clearance, structure or feasibility
Require separate study by qualified teams after specialist evidence is complete

hard_constraints.label_zh: 权属、管线、审批与长期维护
hard_constraints.label_en: Ownership, utilities, approvals and long-term maintenance

performance_contract.label_zh: 典型使用者完整无障碍行程
performance_contract.label_en: Complete accessible journey for representative users
performance_contract.sampling_zh: 轮椅使用者、老年人、照护者和推车使用者分群陪同走查；记录时段与施工状态。
performance_contract.sampling_en: Escorted, disaggregated audits with wheelchair users, older people, carers and pram users; record time and construction state.
performance_contract.stop_rule_zh: 出现新增断链、无法安全完成或任何分群明显恶化即停。
performance_contract.stop_rule_en: Stop for any new break, unsafe completion or material deterioration for any group.

performance_contract.sampling_zh: 高需求与低需求时段人工观察；不使用人脸识别或个体追踪。
performance_contract.sampling_en: Manual observation in high- and low-demand periods; no facial recognition or individual tracking.
performance_contract.stop_rule_zh: 严重安全事件、等待上升或风险转移至其他使用者即停。
performance_contract.stop_rule_en: Stop after a serious safety event, increased waiting or transfer of risk to another user group.

performance_contract.label_zh: 无障碍与人工服务可用率
performance_contract.label_en: Availability of accessible and staffed service
performance_contract.sampling_zh: 按公布服务时段抽查，并记录故障、施工与信息更新时间。
performance_contract.sampling_en: Sample against published service hours and record outages, works and information updates.
performance_contract.stop_rule_zh: 数字服务替代人工入口、信息过期或完整路径失效即停。
performance_contract.stop_rule_en: Stop if digital service replaces staffed access, information is stale or the complete path fails.

performance_contract.label_zh: 维护工时与全周期费用
performance_contract.sampling_zh: 记录巡检、清洁、设备、人工服务和撤除恢复成本。
performance_contract.sampling_en: Record inspection, cleaning, equipment, staffed service and removal/reinstatement costs.
performance_contract.stop_rule_zh: 责任主体未确认或超过经批准运维能力即不扩展。
performance_contract.stop_rule_en: Do not scale if the responsible operator is unconfirmed or approved maintenance capacity is exceeded.

raci.responsible_zh: 有资质的规划、交通与无障碍联合调查团队
raci.responsible_en: Qualified joint planning, transport and accessibility survey team
raci.accountable_zh: 拟议项目召集方，待确认
raci.accountable_en: Proposed project convenor, to be confirmed
raci.consulted_zh: 站点、道路、公园运营方及受影响使用者
raci.consulted_en: Station, road and park operators and affected users

raci.responsible_zh: 专业团队与 AI 决策支持团队
raci.responsible_en: Professional team and AI decision-support team
raci.accountable_zh: 拟议项目召集方，待确认
raci.accountable_en: Proposed project convenor, to be confirmed
raci.consulted_zh: 安全、无障碍、数据合规、运维与公众代表
raci.consulted_en: Safety, accessibility, data-compliance, operations and public representatives

raci.responsible_zh: 依法具备相应资格的专业与运营主体
raci.responsible_en: Legally competent professional and operating entities
raci.accountable_zh: 相应主管部门，未在本提案中指定
raci.accountable_en: Competent authority, not designated by this proposal
raci.consulted_zh: 产权、应急、安全及受影响使用者
raci.consulted_en: Ownership, emergency, safety and affected-user representatives

raci.accountable_zh: 依法负责的主管主体，待确认
raci.accountable_en: Legally accountable authority, to be confirmed
raci.consulted_zh: 独立安全与无障碍复核、公众代表
raci.consulted_en: Independent safety and accessibility review and public representatives
raci.informed_zh: 公开停止记录及所有参与方
raci.informed_en: Public stop record and all participants

immediate_pause_triggers_zh: 严重安全事件或风险信号
immediate_pause_triggers_en: Break in the complete accessible chain
Failure of responsibility or maintenance capacity
stop_responsibility.resume_rule_zh: 暂停原因被记录、修复并由相应责任主体与受影响使用者复核后，方可恢复。
stop_responsibility.resume_rule_en: Resume only after the pause reason is recorded, repaired and reviewed by the accountable entity and affected users.
